newsitem.title: USA: Sequus FDA ruling not seen significant.
newsitem.headline: Sequus FDA ruling not seen significant.

text.p: Analysts said Monday they did not see a significant impact on Sequus Pharmaeuticals sales resulting from an FDA Advisory Panel's ruling rejecting its Amphotec drug as a treatment for febrile neutropenia in patients who fail anti-bacterial therapy.
They said that since the drug is already approved and is on the market for related conditions, doctors already have the option of prescribing it for off-label uses.

"Obviously it would have been nice for them to get it approved," said Dillon Read analyst Mary Ann Gray. But she added that the drug is already reaching the febrile neutropenia patients through off-label use.
Sequus shares were halted on NASDAQ pending the FDA announcement and did not resume for trading on Monday.
